description: The source is a flat mauve 0x8060a0 -- three channels, all mid-range and all different -- so every knob moves it visibly and none of them moves it by accident. Temperature at 0.6 warms it: red gains 15%, blue loses 15%, green is untouched. A build tinting by an offset rather than a gain, or moving green with the other two, produces a different colour. The green channel staying exactly 0x60 is the assertion.
